policy.concurrency: read current api.local.jsonc only; no override or CLI control
policy.service_failures: retain raw calls and usage; exclude from project max_requests and task max_attempts; stop dispatch on first service failure
policy.model_result_failures: continue to count malformed results, truncation and reasoning budget exhaustion
policy.historical_credits: new calls bind raw task_attempt; legacy initial calls grouped by session, repair parts conservatively by token/round

usage: No usage returned for the failed API probe; not treated as zero billing
known_limit: Legacy repair parts without exact attempt binding receive conservative credits; raw history is never rewritten
